brief: Proposed small freestanding wood trail marker with a single carved notch and broad timber foot; not a gameplay beacon or signage system.

design_sources.section: Greenlands fixture and acceptance cards / E1-B
design_sources.role: calls for a stable landmark and clear return navigation
records existing landmark artwork, reused and not regenerated
optional style reference; not prop requirements

concept_status: agent-selected; proposal, user approval not claimed
clean_view_status: ready-for-model-test; opaque background, segmentation required if later adapter requires alpha
component_boundaries: One marker post and attached timber base
Excludes the existing Greenlands Waystone, paths, signage, writing and navigation mechanics
scale: Approximate scale inferred; no dimension is established by the design source.
edits: No pixel edits or upscaling. First clean view changed the timber base to stone; second prompt corrected it against the selected sheet.

findings: Sheet views consistently depict a single upright notched timber post with a flared joined-timber foot.
Initial clean view incorrectly substituted a stone foot and was rejected.
Final clean view has a matching timber foot, top notch, complete silhouette and neutral opaque background.
No text, insignia or unrelated objects present.
unresolved: The notch suggests direction visually but orientation/function is intentionally unspecified; scale is approximate.
